thread:
Maya: Getting a bunch of 504s in Kibana when I try to join logs + traces for eu-west1 GPU reclaim window. Started ~09:12 UTC.
Sam: saw that too. Grafana panel `loki.query_latency_ms` spiked and a few loki-master pods OOM-killed earlier.
Irene: can you paste the exact query you're running?
Maya: here's what I ran — small window but heavy fanout: ```
{app="inference"} | json | trace_id="8a3f..." | sort @timestamp desc
``` getting `504 Gateway Time-out` from kibana-proxy.
Sam: looks like the query is fanouting across many tenants because trace_id is indexed as label only in some shards. loki backend ends up querying >20 ingesters.
ingest-bot: ALERT: loki_query_timeout eu-west1-shard-3 firing (avg latency 12.4s) :rotating_light:
Nate: eu-west1 had NAT rotation earlier this morning (infra change), could be causing transient egress flaps to logging endpoints; that can increase retries and timeouts in query fanout.
Leo: also saw increased goroutine counts on loki queriers and large iterator churn — likely repeated streaming RPCs. Could be KV cache thrash.
Irene: two quick checks: 1) reduce time range to 30s and see if query succeeds. 2) run the same trace_id search scoped to `tenant="gpu-prod"` to avoid global fanout.
Maya: reduced to 30s and it returned, but still slow (2.1s). Full-window still 504. So fanout is the issue.
Sam: for immediate mitigation we can: 1) limit Kibana to shard-aware queries (if req_id present) 2) bump loki_query_timeout for eu-west1 horizontal pool 3) add sampling on dashboard to avoid wide trace joins.
Nate: bumping timeout helps user UX but hides underlying cost. We should investigate why >20 ingesters are contacted — probably index label stratification broke after index rotation during shard maintenance.
Leo: thinking we also need a Grafana alert for "query fanout >10" to catch this before kibana times out. Right now we only alert on overall latency.
Irene: I ran a quick loki query on shard metadata: ```
GET /index/metadata?shard=eu-west1
# response: some index mappings for trace_id missing on shard-3
```
Maya: ok that explains it. Index rotation job probably skipped shard-3 during maintenance window. Who touched index-rotation job? @Nate? :thinking:
Nate: I triggered a config rollout at 08:55 for NAT fix. Didn't touch index rotation job. But there was a coincident cron overlap, might have caused transient lock contention.
Sam: action plan: (a) re-run index-rotation for eu-west1 shard-3 (b) add a preflight check to index-rotation to verify label count per shard (c) add fanout alert and a dashboard panel showing per-shard query counts.
Irene: I'll file the index-rotation rerun, schedule it in the next 10m and watch `loki.query_fanout_count`. Assigning to Nate for correlation with NAT rotation logs.
Maya: thanks — will update SLO incident doc: latency SLO for central-log-join impacted for ~09:12-09:25 UTC. Notifying product owners.
Nate: I'll correlate VPC/NAT logs and check egress flaps. If we confirm overlap, I'll add a lock to prevent concurrent maintenance jobs.
Leo: I'll spin up a temporary extra querier replica to soak queries until index rotation fixes the mapping.
Sam: follow-up: consider adding a fallback in Kibana to run a shard-scoped search when fanout exceeds threshold to avoid user-facing 504s.
Maya: noted. thanks everyone. I'll close out once rotation completes and kibana queries are stable. :thumbsup:
